brief:
Settlers attacked Palestinian vehicles near the roundabout of Tuqu town, located southeast of Bethlehem, on Monday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The assault targeted civilians traveling through the area as tensions remain high in the occupied West Bank.

The incident took place amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the Bethlehem region. Israeli occupation forces have maintained a significant presence in Palestinian communities, conducting raids and patrols that frequently coincide with settler violence against Palestinian residents and their property.
